### CVE-2013-0177
- Assigner: redhat | Published: 2014-01-30 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 38230: Apache OFBiz 10.4.x - Multiple Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerabilities (remote/multiple, 2013-01-18, verified=1)

Multiple cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities in widget/screen/ModelScreenWidget.java in Apache Open For Business Project (aka OFBiz) 10.04.x before 10.04.05, 11.04.01, and possibly 09.04.x allow remote authenticated users to inject arbitrary web script or HTML via the (1) Screenlet.title or (2) Image.alt Widget attribute, as demonstrated by the parentPortalPageId parameter to exampleext/control/ManagePortalPages.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a

### CVE-2013-10075 — Apache::Session versions through 1.94 for Perl re-creates deleted sessions
- Assigner: CPANSec | Published: 2026-05-08 | Updated: 2026-05-08 | Max CVSS: 9.1
- CWE: CWE-672 CWE-672 Operation on a Resource after Expiration or Release
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 9.1 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total

Apache::Session versions through 1.94 for Perl re-creates deleted sessions.

The session stores Apache::Session::Store::File and Apache::Session::Store::DB_File will create a session that does not exist.  This can lead to sessions being revived, potentially with data that was to be deleted.

**workarounds:** Use a database store based on Apache::Session::Store::DBI.

Affected:
